data.content: INVESTIGATION: A3 provider-concurrency TOCTOU-safety hinges on withBridgeLock(agentId,fn) delegating to a SINGLE global .store.lock (agent-tools.ts:713; agentId/scope is error-message-only, comment :704). check(:1910)+increment(transitionAgent busy :1921)+save(:1944) serialize across ALL agents/providers before bridge spawn (:1945). Per-agent lock granularity would have broken the cap; the global lock is what makes it sound.
